** UPDATED PMWA **
Dispatch is working to schedule a technician. As soon as a tech is assigned, I will update the ETA in PMWA. We are handling several emergencies and will address this as soon as we can.
Single case runnig warm

7/1
Arrived on site. Checked in with PML Tony. Here for A02 running warm. Upon arrival seen A02-T1 running warm. Checked case. No airflow. They pulled A02-T2. T2 never alarmed. That case had airflow and fan out. Replaced motor from truck stock. All fans working in T2. Good airflow. Had to wait for them to pull product to thaw out case with hot water. All fans working in T1 also. Put case in defrost. Verified hot gas defrost works. Fans shut off in defrost. Product was pulled. Found drain pan iced up. Clogged drain. Drain pan heater works. Thawed out drain pan and back of coil. Water going down properly now. Actuator on top of case is working. After put case back together. Turned hand vlave back on. All fans work. Have good airflow. Waited for case to come down to temp. Noticed termination sensors not reading correctly. Replaced both T1 and T2 termination sensors. Monitored case. Adjusted tension on some doors. All doors closing properly. A02 cases temping good. . Team will fill product back up tomorrow. Job completed.
No injuries were reported on this job.
Tech was NOT onsite for another call.
